mapper.select: SELECT c.category AS category, c.unit AS unit, COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) AS chemical_count, COUNT(b.id) AS batch_count, COALESCE(SUM(b.available_quantity), 0) AS total_available, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN b.usable_until >= #{today} AND b.usable_until <= #{threshold} THEN b.available_quantity ELSE 0 END), 0) AS expiring_quantity, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN b.usable_until < #{today} THEN b.available_quantity ELSE 0 END), 0) AS expired_quantity FROM chemical c LEFT JOIN chemical_batch b ON b.chemical_id = c.id AND b.available_quantity > 0 GROUP BY c.category, c.unit ORDER BY c.category, c.unit

SELECT CAST(created_at AS DATE) AS stat_date, change_type AS change_type, COUNT(*) AS record_count, COALESCE(SUM(quantity), 0) AS total_quantity FROM stock_ledger WHERE created_at >= #{since} GROUP BY CAST(created_at AS DATE), change_type ORDER BY CAST(created_at AS DATE) DESC, change_type
